issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted corporate operational-control transfer record for the complete control-plane denominator.

## Primary deliverable

One accepted control-plane transfer record covering every named operational authority.

## Verification result

Corporate-owner, business-account, deployment, availability, recovery, and rollback readbacks pass for the complete control-plane denominator.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one corporate control-transfer acceptance decision; individual control-plane transfers and readbacks are denominator rows, not separately closeable results.

## Dependencies

- CORP-A: #482
- CORP-B: #483
- AWS-G: #496
- GCP-D: #493

## Retained predecessor scope

- #157
- #158
- #159

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each control plane has corporate owner and rollback
- [ ] AWS uses the approved business account
- [ ] Terraform and CI authority are company-controlled
- [ ] Availability and recovery readbacks pass

## Owned paths

- `docs/operations/corporate/control-transfer/**`
- `infra/**`
- `.github/workflows/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/corporate/corp-c/**`

## PVF lanes

- `control-plane-readback`
- `aws-business-account`
- `deployment-rollback`
- `secret-redaction`

## Stop conditions

- Rollback is unavailable
- Personal billing remains authoritative
- A production mutation lacks operator authorization

## Non-goals

- Unreviewed production cutover
- Credential disclosure
